C1163.title: Berlin DPA Orders Apple and Google to Remove DeepSeek App
C1163.summary: Reported on September 30, 2025, the Berlin Data Protection Authority invoked Article 16 of the Digital Services Act to notify Apple and Google, demanding the removal of the DeepSeek application over alleged GDPR violations involving unlawful data transfers to China.
